question: A low pitched but louder sound has _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**lower frequency and higher amplitude**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Lower frequency and higher amplitude** characterize a low-pitched but louder sound.
 
• Frequency is related to the pitch of the sound: **lower frequency** means a lower pitch.
